evidence: Reciprocal actual-production Game controls isolate the assertion typedef identifier as a cause of comment-only generated-code changes. VC6 has no __COUNTER__. Repeated identical char[1] typedefs enforce true assertions at file/namespace/class/function scope; false assertions fail C2118.
payload.hypothesis: Private assertion typedef names depend on source line and perturb VC6 code generation during otherwise comment-only edits.
